tools.name: get_claim
tools.description:
Retrieve a claim record by its claim number.
Returns the claimant name as recorded, which may contain non-ASCII characters.

claimant_hint.description: Optional claimant name to disambiguate, e.g. "José Álvarez" or "Zoë Müller".

tools.name: lookup_policy
tools.description: Retrieve the policy terms that apply to a claim, including coverage limits and exclusions.

tools.name: classify_claim
tools.description: Record a routing decision for a claim. Use exactly one of: approve, deny, escalate.

rationale.description: Cite the policy clause relied on.

tools.name: search_precedent
tools.description: Search previously decided claims for comparable fact patterns.
